#Setup code

```{r}
student_id <- c("S01", "S02", "S03", "S04", "S05", "S06")
section <- c("A", "B", "A", "B", "A", "B")
quiz1 <- c(82, 91, 76, 88, 95, 69)
quiz2 <- c(85, 89, 80, 92, 94, 74)
passed <- c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE)
```

# Part A
```{r}
section <- factor(section, levels = c("A", "B"))
 
# data frame containing all five vectors
students <- data.frame(
  student_id = student_id,
  section    = section,
  quiz1      = quiz1,
  quiz2      = quiz2,
  passed     = passed,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
 
# matrix: students as rows, quizzes as columns
score_matrix <- matrix(
  c(quiz1, quiz2),
  nrow = 6, ncol = 2,
  dimnames = list(student_id, c("quiz1", "quiz2"))
)
 
# list containing course, scores, and a named cutoffs vector
course_record <- list(
  course  = "R Programming",
  scores  = students,
  cutoffs = c(pass = 70, excellent = 90)
)
 
# Inspect the objects
typeof(section);      class(section);      length(section);      str(section)
typeof(students);     class(students);     length(students);     str(students);     dim(students)
typeof(score_matrix); class(score_matrix); length(score_matrix); str(score_matrix); dim(score_matrix)
typeof(course_record);class(course_record);length(course_record);str(course_record)
```

```{r}
section <- factor(section, levels = c("A","B"))

students <- data.frame(
  student_id = student_id,
  section = section,
  quiz1 = quiz1,
  quiz2 = quiz2,
  passed = passed,
  stringAsFactors = FALSE
)

score_matrix <- matrix(
  c(quiz1, quiz2),
  nrow = 6, ncol = 2, 
  dimnames = list(student_id, c("quiz1","quiz2"))
)

course_record <- list(course = "R Programming", 
                      score = students, 
                      cutoffs = c(pass = 70, excellent = 90))

typeof(quiz1); class(quiz1); length(quiz1)
typeof(section); class(section); length(section)
typeof(score_matrix); class(score_matrix); dim(score_matrix)
typeof(students); class(students); dim(students)
typeof(course_record); class(course_record); length(course_record)

# A vector contains elements of one atomic type
# List: Contain elements of different types and lengths
# Matrix:  An atomic vectpr with a 2d dim attribute
# Data Frame: A list of equal-length vector
```

# Part B
```{r}
score_matrix["S04", "quiz2"]

score_matrix[1:2, , drop = FALSE]

course_record["course"]
course_record[["course"]]
course_record$course


# [ always preserves the structure. [[ extracts a single
# element and returns the element itself.
# $ returns a named element

```

```{r}
# row-wise mean of the two quizzes
students$average <- rowMeans(students[, c("quiz1", "quiz2")])
 
# TRUE when average >= 90
students$excellent <- students$average >= 90
 
# section A students with average >= 80
section_A_high <- students[students$section == "A" & students$average >= 80, ]
 
# only student_id, section, average for that subset
section_A_high[, c("student_id", "section", "average")]
 
# named numeric vector of all student averages
avg_by_student <- students$average
names(avg_by_student) <- students$student_id
avg_by_student

```
# Part C
```{r}
students$average <- rowMeans(students[, c("quiz1", "quiz2")])
 
students$excellent <- students$average >= 90

section_A <- students[students$section == "A" & students$average >= 80, ]

section_A[, c("student_id", "section", "average")]

avg_by_student <- students$average
names(avg_by_student) <- students$student_id

# The calculations are vectorized because it is faster than element-by-element loops.
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
measurements <- read.csv(text = csv_text, na.strings = c("", "NA"),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

head(measurements)
str(measurements)
dim(measurements)
names(measurements)

colSums(is.na(measurements))

measurements_complete <- measurements[complete.cases(measurements), ]

removed_ids <- measurements$sample_id[!complete.cases(measurements)]

```

# Part B

```{r}
measurements$site   <- factor(measurements$site)
measurements$status <- factor(measurements$status)
levels(measurements$site)
levels(measurements$status)

measurements$temp_f <- measurements$temp_c * 9 / 5 + 32

measurements$ph_below_7 <- measurements$ph < 7

ns_ok <- measurements[
  complete.cases(measurements) &
    measurements$site %in% c("North", "South") &
    measurements$status == "ok",
]

ns_ok[, c("sample_id", "site", "temp_c", "temp_f", "ph")]
mean(measurements$temp_c, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(measurements$temp_c[measurements$site == "South"], na.rm = TRUE)

```

# Problem 3

```{r}
#Setup
student_id <- paste0("P", sprintf("%02d", 1:8))
scores <- c(95, 82, NA, 67, 74, 88, 59, 91)
```

```{r}
# Part A
grade_one <- function(
    score,
    a_min = 90,
    b_min = 80,
    c_min = 70,
    d_min = 60
) {
  if (is.na(score)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  } else if (score >= a_min) {
    return("A")
  } else if (score >= b_min) {
    return("B")
  } else if (score >= c_min) {
    return("C")
  } else if (score >= d_min) {
    return("D")
  } else {
    return("F")
  }
}

grade_one(NA)
grade_one(90)
grade_one(80)
grade_one(85)
grade_one(74)
```
# Part B
```{r}
grades <- rep(NA_character_, length(scores))
for (i in seq_along(scores)) {
  grades[i] <- grade_one(scores[i])
}
names(grades) <- student_id
grades

# i represents the integer index position.

```

# Part C-1
```{r}
summarize_scores <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE, digits = 1) {
  c(
    count = length(x),
    missing = sum(is.na(x)),
    mean = round(mean(x, na.rm = na.rm), digits),
    sd = round(sd(x, na.rm = na.rm), digits),
    min = round(min(x, na.rm = na.rm), digits),
    max = round(max(x, na.rm = na.rm), digits)
  )
}

summarize_scores(scores)
summarize_scores(x = scores, na.rm = TRUE, digits = 2)

# Part C-2
plot_scores <- function(x, ...) {
  plot(seq_along(x), x, ...)
}

plot_scores(scores, type = "b", pch = 19, xlab = "Position", ylab = "Score", main = "Student Scores")
```
